notes.title: Demo Update Announcement
notes.content: [p]We have made significant updates to the demo, including the following:[/p][p]1. Added dozens of new skills, now there are more skill options for upgrading![/p][p]2. Add a large number of new troops/units, and after killing the boss, they will gradually join the battlefield![/p][p]If you are interested in our game, please add your wish list![/p][p]Your support and attention are the driving force behind our continuous creation![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528095/836c4eee246c44118b826190afa787d666c24c8d.png"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: 1. Added dozens of new skills, now there are more skill options for upgrading!
2. Add a large number of new troops/units, and after killing the boss, they will gradually join the battlefield!
